EVALF.justification: The negative movement where the soul is distracted by worldly images.

phase_3.void_description: The state of the soul before the call to contemplation, lacking direction.
phase_3.true_description: The state of the soul aligned with the Divine will through love.
phase_3.false_description: The state of the soul distracted by the multiplicity of created things.
phase_3.both_description: The apophatic state where the soul experiences God as a darkness that is also light.

steps.domain_action: The soul begins in a state of naked intent, stripped of all intellectual concepts.
The soul recognizes its own existence and its separation from the Creator.
The soul directs a sharp dart of longing love toward the Divine.
The soul casts all thoughts of creatures into the cloud of forgetting.
The soul distinguishes between the active duties of the world and the contemplative work.
The soul follows the path of Mary, choosing the better part of silent adoration.
The soul rejects the distractions of the active life during the time of prayer.
The soul reunites its focus into a single point of desire for God.
The soul chains these moments of desire into a continuous contemplative state.
The soul enters the Cloud of Unknowing, where God is both present and hidden.
The soul records this encounter in its spiritual essence, permanently altering its nature.
The soul reaches the terminal state of union where the work is completed in God.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit who translates the soul's silent longing into spiritual movement.

phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The divine call which determines the timing of the contemplative entry.
phase_5.alfs_store: The scriptures and the teachings of the Church which provide the framework for the work.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The effort of the will to maintain focus against distraction.

phase_6.post_cycle_state: A soul unified in a single desire for the Divine.
